basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Senior Full-Stack Engineer & AI Builder | TypeScript, Node.js | 3× Founder | Open Source
basics.summary: Senior full-stack engineer shipping TypeScript, Node.js, and Vue in production at scale. 13+ years across enterprise-grade systems: distributed templating engine at Beekeeper powers 15% of all assets for 10M+ users, Employee Referral System became the platform's top revenue channel ($1.5M+ generated). Lead AI Engineer at LumApps applying agentic AI to real customer workflows (2x conversions, $1M forecast quarterly), including novel applications of LLMs to enterprise data infrastructure. Founding engineer at Dronistics, 3 AI products founded solo through Anand Creations, and open-source contributor since Robogen at EPFL. Bias to action; comfortable on customer calls and in code the same afternoon.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Shipped production multi-agent workflows on Python and TypeScript (LangGraph, Google ADK, MCP, AG-UI). Novel application of agentic AI to enterprise CRM data: 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, $1M forecast quarterly.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti/Neo4j that unifies 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, product usage) into one secure, time-aware store agents read and write to. Data modeling and API design for infrastructure that has to be trustworthy.
Own the reliability layer: evals, LangSmith tracing, cost-per-request instrumentation, fallback paths, and on-call. Communicate directly with senior stakeholders and C-level on outcomes.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Architected Employee Referral System end to end (TypeScript, Vue, Node.js, Java, PostgreSQL). Became the platform's top revenue channel: $1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR. Direct engagement with enterprise customers from discovery through post-launch.

Designed a distributed templating engine (Kafka, Elastic Search, microfrontends) that cut customer setup time 90% and powers 15% of all assets on the platform (10M+ users). Product Owner; full-stack ownership.
Replaced $337K/yr in vendor translation costs with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks (GitHub Actions + OpenAI). Bias to action, calculated risk, iterate in production.
Ran observability and global on-call (K8s, AWS, Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io). Hired and mentored the AI engineering cohort; engineers now lead features independently.

work.name: Dronistics (EPFL spin-off)
highlights: Founding engineer at a startup. Shipped full stack (Vue, Node.js, Java, PostgreSQL, real-time APIs, AWS/Docker/Terraform infra) from empty repo to 500+ real-world deliveries.
Direct engagement with enterprise partners (Unilever) and CES Las Vegas showcase. Turned prototype demos into signed opportunities.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
work.position: AI Research Engineer & Open Source Maintainer
highlights: Built and open-sourced Robogen, a platform used by researchers and students to design, evolve, and 3D-print real robots. Featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Migrated the simulation pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel evolution; secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research.
TA for Evolutionary Robotics; supervised 20+ master's students on optimization, neural networks, and embodied learning.
